thread:
Sana (Helixa): Hey Redwood team — Helixa is ready to onboard a custom claims summarizer (finetuned 13B, will be quantized to 8-bit). Hard constraints: PHI-safe, VPC-only inference, customer-managed HSM (Azure Key Vault HSM), and pre-prod safety/eval pass. Target window: start of Q2. Who should we loop in and what are the immediate next steps? cc @Maria (CS)
Maria (CS): Thanks @Sana. Quick clarifying q's: 1) Will any training or label data leave your VPC? 2) Rough peak qps and a latency SLO? 3) Do you expect to run on Redwood Private or want Dedicated?
Sana (Helixa): No training data leaves our VPC — inference only. We can share scrubbed samples via VPC S3. Peak ~400 qps steady-state; initial canary 10–30 qps. Latency target p95 <=350ms. We want Private (VPC) with customer-managed HSM.
Maria (CS): Looping in Priya for safety/evals, Jae for artifact + ops, Omar for security/HSM, Lin for rollout.
Priya (ML): For safety evaluations we'll need: ~1k red-team prompts focusing on PHI probes, ~500 benign prompts, and ~200 labeled summaries if you can provide. We'll run leakage scans, faithfulness/hallucination checks, and automated policy matches. Preferred upload: presigned S3 with VPC endpoint or encrypted artifact transfer.
Sana (Helixa): We can produce a scrubbed 1k set within 48h via presigned VPC S3 URL. Full labeled set needs legal signoff.
Jae (Solutions): Deployment questions: artifact format (HF .pt, .safetensors, gguf), exact quantization tool and version, context length expectations, and KV cache pattern. For Private we need artifact checksum and a reproducible filename (e.g., helixa_claims_v1.safetensors).
Sana (Helixa): Artifact will be helixa_claims_v1.safetensors, quantized with intel/q8-recipe v0.9. Contexts up to 2k.
Omar (Security): Noted customer-managed HSM (Azure KV HSM) and region? We need a SOC2 excerpt, KMS policy template, and the cloud region (so we can validate routing). HSM provisioning typically adds ~2 weeks; flagging as schedule risk.
Sana (Helixa): Region is eu-west-1. We'll share SOC2 excerpt and legal contact. We require customer-managed HSM, cloud KMS alone is insufficient.
Lin (EngOps): I'll create an intake project and propose rollout steps: 1) sample ingest & safety eval (Priya) 2) staging deploy with Private runtime (Jae) 3) 24h safety canary (5% traffic) 4) ramp to 25% then full. I'll add owners and timelines.
deploy-bot: Created task https://rwd.company/tasks/78211 "Helixa claims summarizer intake" and assigned Maria, Priya, Jae, Omar, Lin :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): Renewal / account health note: Helixa is evaluating Dedicated vs Private; positive early ops & safety experience increases chance of a multi-year Dedicated commitment. I'll capture enablement artifacts to support renewal motion.
Sana (Helixa): Requested kickoff next Wed 09:00 UTC. We'll provide scrubbed samples and SOC2 excerpt.
Priya (ML): With sample data in hand we estimate ~3 business days to run initial safety/eval bench and produce a concise report with recommended guardrails (response filters, prompt sanitizers, policy thresholds).
Jae (Solutions): If Helixa can share a small perf CSV (latency per token) from local runs, that helps pre-size the Private cluster and optimize batch settings.
Sana (Helixa): I'll ask infra for the perf CSV and share via S3.
Lin (EngOps): Action items for Redwood: Maria will collect SOW + legal contact; Jae will validate artifact acceptance and staging infra; Priya will prep eval harness and red-team templates; Omar will start HSM onboarding checklist; Lin will schedule kickoff and create project board.
Maria (CS): @Sana I'll DM SOW template and legal contact request. Also let us know any enablement collateral you want in the handoff. :handshake: 
Sana (Helixa): Thanks all — appreciate the quick response. Looking forward to kickoff. :rocket:
